fields.content: Holtz is a Claude Code plugin that performs systematic, TDD-driven bug hunting on codebases. It runs a seven-phase audit process (recon, doc audit, test quality audit, adversarial code review, TDD fix loop, pattern analysis, convergence loop), documents every defect in a structured punchlist, fixes them with failing-test-first methodology, and repeats until two consecutive passes produce no new findings. It is part of a plugin family alongside Janna (specs/assembly), Giles (sprints), and Snyder

```
holtz/
  .claude-plugin/
    plugin.json               # Plugin manifest (name, version, keywords)
  agents/
    holtz.md                   # Agent definition (persona, model=opus, references)
  skills/holtz/
    SKILL.md                   # Skill definition (phases, rules, methodology)
    scripts/
      markdown_utils.py        # Shared utility: mask_code_fences()
      convergence_check.py     # Convergence tracker (punchlist counts, test runner, history)
      validate_punchlist.py    #

### 1. `skills/holtz/scripts/markdown_utils.py` (53 lines)

Shared utility providing `mask_code_fences(content)`. Returns `(normalized, masked)` tuple where normalized has CRLF converted to LF, and masked additionally has all content inside fenced code blocks (both backtick and tilde) replaced with empty lines. Handles nested fences via delimiter-count matching. Line count is preserved between normalized and masked for positional slicing.
